resources.string: Shows a completely black, silent, touch-blocking screen. To leave it, tap 3 times, then press Volume Down 3 times within 10 seconds.
Pixel and Android reserve the real power button. Accessibility key filtering does not receive it, so this app cannot disable that safety control.
Do Not Disturb access: not allowed (optional)
Open display settings for Always-on display
The power button cannot be blocked

On Pixel phones, Android handles Power before app and accessibility-service key callbacks. Accessibility cannot intercept Power. When Android shows this activity above the lock screen, Turn Off keeps it black without dismissing device security. Always-on display is system-owned; disable it manually in Pixel display settings.
